title: On the triple tangent planes to a surface of the third order
venue: The Cambridge and Dublin Mathematical Journal
notes: Original 1849 article. Section VI, printed pages 258–260, derives the line count from the degree of the locus of points admitting a line with fourth-order contact. The cubic specialization gives degree 27 on printed page 260. Section V, printed pages 255–258, also studies singular cubic surfaces and their weighted line counts.
